git_errors_config_failed: Could not save {key} in your git config.
git_errors_config_failed_output: Could not save {key} in your git config: {output}
git_errors_conflict: Git stopped on a merge conflict. Resolve the conflicted files, stage them and continue.
git_errors_identity_email: Enter an e-mail address like you@example.com.
git_errors_local_changes: Local changes would be overwritten. Commit or stash them, then try again.
git_errors_locked: Another git process is using this repository, or it stopped and left a lock file. Wait a moment, then try again.
git_errors_no_commits: This repository has no commits yet. Make a first commit, then try again.
git_errors_no_remote: This repository has no remote. Add one that points to GitHub, then try again.
git_errors_no_upstream: This branch has not been pushed yet, so it has nothing to compare with on the remote.
git_errors_not_repo: This folder is not a git repository.
git_errors_nothing_to_commit: Nothing to commit. Stage some changes first.
git_errors_other: Git could not finish that command. See the details for what it printed.
git_errors_rejected: The remote has commits you don't have. Pull, then push again.
git_errors_remote_access: Git could not reach the remote or sign in to it. Check the address and your credentials.
